description: Is this address a contract, on Ethereum, Base, Arc or BNB Chain: code size, the implementation behind an EIP-1967 or ZeppelinOS proxy, and an EIP-7702 delegation. $0.001 per call over x402 (USDC on Arc, Base or Solana, or XNT on X1).
